title: Plan the store shift
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: As Floor Specialist, turn the opening work into a prioritized planning checklist without claiming execution.

answer.question: As Floor Specialist, turn the opening work into a prioritized planning checklist without claiming execution.
answer.answer:
Here's the opening-shift planning checklist — **this is a plan only, nothing has been executed yet** (doors still locked, POS still off, signage not yet updated, etc.):

**Opening Shift — ~57 min total, prioritized**

| # | Task | Priority | Est. Time |
|---|------|----------|-----------|
| 1 | Unlock entrance doors, disable alarm | CRITICAL | 2 min |
| 2 | Power on POS terminals, verify connectivity | CRITICAL | 5 min |
| 3 | Walk floor to check overnight display condition | HIGH | 10 min |
| 4 | Review daily promotions, update signage | HIGH | 15 min |
| 5 | Check inventory alerts, pull items for replenishment | HIGH | 20 min |
| 6 | Restock fitting rooms with hangers | MEDIUM | 5 min |

Suggested order follows the priority column — critical safety/systems tasks first, then customer-facing prep, then lower-priority upkeep. Let me know if you want this re-sequenced by zone or split across multiple associates — I can regenerate the checklist, but someone on the floor still needs to actually carry it out.
